scope: M1 closure remediation: exact local-model context accounting and absolute wall deadlines

implementation.context_semantics: ModelLoadProfile.context_tokens is an input allowance. Managed llama.cpp server context is input allowance plus output_reserve_tokens and must fit ModelCapabilities.max_context_tokens.
implementation.preflight: LocalOpenAiBackend renders the exact provider chat template through /apply-template, tokenizes the rendered prompt, conservatively token-charges a structured-output contract, and rejects the request before inference when admitted input or input-plus-output exceeds the active budgets.
implementation.wall_deadline: One Instant deadline is shared by template rendering, tokenization, connect/write/read and completion. Socket operation timeouts are recomputed from remaining wall time instead of resetting the full timeout per operation.
implementation.provider_independence: The provider-specific rendering/tokenization stays inside LocalOpenAiBackend; Controller-facing ModelRequest/ModelResponse authority semantics remain provider-neutral.

real_short_smoke.qualification: This remains a short tool-call viability/accounting smoke, not the representative full engineering packet required for M1 closure.

remaining_gate: Representative compiler/controller engineering packets, real edit/verification, repair, checkpoint and restart must still be qualified under M1-T10/T07/T08/T09 before M1 closes.
